userGroups.changeFailed: The group couldn't be changed. Try again.

creationHint.members: Members create groups and manage the ones they create. Guests cannot.
creationHint.admins: Only owners and administrators create groups. Existing groups stay.

edits.title: Edit history
edits.description: Earlier versions of this message, the newest first.
edits.descriptionOwn: Earlier versions of your message, the newest first. You can put one back.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Press Ctrl+/ anywhere to see this list.
shortcuts.jump: Jump to a channel or person
shortcuts.details: Show or hide the details panel
shortcuts.editLast: Edit your last message (empty message box)
shortcuts.replyLast: Reply to the last message in its thread (empty message box)

priority.title: Priority
priority.persistentHint: Every {{minutes}} minutes, up to {{times}} times, until they acknowledge it. For urgent messages that mention someone.
priority.ackFailed: Couldn't save your acknowledgement. Try again.
priority.reminderTitle: Urgent message from {{name}} waits for you
priority.settingHint: An urgent message can remind the people it mentions until they acknowledge it.

receipts.shareHint: Where a workspace turned read receipts on, others in a conversation see that you read their messages. Off, you see theirs neither.
receipts.settingHint: People see in direct and group conversations who has read their messages. Each person can keep theirs to themselves.

interactions.failed: The app did not answer. Try again later.
interactions.unavailable: The app behind this message takes no interactions now.
interactions.dialogFrom: An app asks for this. What you enter goes to it.

console.title: System console

sections.overview: The installation at a glance and its settings.
sections.people: Everyone who signed in, across workspaces. Accounts are managed in Cenacle ID.
sections.bots: Every bot of every workspace. A bot turned off cannot use its tokens or webhooks.
sections.jobs: Work the server does in the background, by kind, and the latest failures.
sections.notifications: What notifications outside the app may show. Lock screens and inboxes show them.
sections.security: How long sessions last and which networks may sign in and use the administration.
sections.federation: Which other Cenacle servers the workspaces may connect to.
sections.audit: Everything administrators and people did that matters for security, across the installation.

console.configHint: From the server's environment; change them there and restart. Secrets show as "set".
console.findPeople: Find people by name, e-mail or username
console.signOutDescription: Every session ends on every device. They can sign in again unless their account is turned off in Cenacle ID.
console.changeFailed: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.

policy.push_contents_full_hint: Who wrote, where and the start of the text.
policy.push_contents_sender_hint: Who wrote and where, without the text.
policy.push_contents_none_hint: "New activity" only: open the app to see it.
policy.email_contents_full_hint: Who wrote, where, when and the start of each text.
policy.email_contents_sender_hint: Who wrote, where and when, without the texts.

security.sessionsHint: 0 means no limit. Shorter limits end sessions that are already older.
security.operator: The server's own limits also apply: {{limits}}.
security.adminNetworks: Networks that may use the administration
security.networksHint: One address or CIDR range per line (10.0.0.0/8, 2001:db8::/32). Empty: every network. Your address is {{address}}; the lists must include it.

federation.deny: Any server except those listed below
federation.serversHint: One host name per line, with a port if it has one (chat.example.com, *.partner.org). Connections to servers left out stop sending and receiving.

audit.streamHint: New events go out within seconds, oldest first; if the receiver is down they wait and go when it is back.
audit.secretHint: Optional: each request carries an X-Cenacle-Signature made with it.
audit.secretKept: A secret is saved; leave empty to keep it.

console.eraseDescription: Their name, address, picture and status are removed and they can no longer sign in. Their messages are deleted, except those a legal hold keeps; their reactions, saved items, scheduled messages and devices go. Also delete them in Cenacle ID if they should not sign in again with a new account.
console.erased: Erased: {{erased}} messages deleted, {{held}} kept by legal holds.

permissions.title: Permission scheme
permissions.hint: Tick what each role may do in this workspace. Changes apply at once.
permissions.owners: Owners may always do everything. Bots stay with the owners and admins; group creation has its own setting under Groups.

hints.create_channels: Public and private channels of this workspace.
hints.invite_people: Create, see and revoke invitation links.
hints.manage_categories: Create categories and move channels between them.
hints.custom_emoji: Upload emoji everyone here can use.
hints.broadcast_mentions: @channel, @here and @all notify everyone in a channel.
hints.group_mentions: Mentioning a group notifies its people.
hints.guest_links: Channel managers let someone from outside join one channel for a while, with a password.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.hint: Leave actions to the channel's managers and the workspace's admins.

guestLinks.title: Guest links
guestLinks.hint: Someone from outside joins only this channel, with the link and its password, until the link ends. No account is needed.
guestLinks.name: For whom (optional)
guestLinks.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Send it separately from the link.
guestLinks.createdHint: Copy it now; it is not shown again.
guestLinks.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the link and copy it.
guestLinks.revoked: The link ended; its guests left the channel.
guestLinks.joinNote: You see only this channel and its people. You leave when the link ends.
guestLinks.invalidTitle: This guest link no longer works.
guestLinks.invalidReason: It ended, was used up or was ended by the channel's managers.
guestLinks.askAgain: Ask whoever sent it for a new link.

spillage.reportHint: This message holds what must not be here (classified, personal or secret). The workspace's spillage reviewers decide whether it is removed everywhere.
spillage.alreadyReported: This message was reported already; the reviewers are on it.
spillage.failed: That did not work. Try again.
spillage.title: Spillage reports
spillage.hint: Remove a reported message everywhere (also from legal holds, devices and shared servers) or dismiss the report. Each decision writes an incident report without the content.
spillage.notReviewer: Only the workspace's spillage reviewers see the reports.
spillage.removeDescription: Its text, edits, files, reactions, mentions and saved copies are deleted, also where a legal hold would keep them; devices and shared servers are told to drop it. Notifications already shown on devices cannot be taken back.
spillage.removed: Removed everywhere. The incident report is ready.
spillage.reviewersHint: Who sees and decides spillage reports. With nobody chosen, the owners do.

archive.title: Archive export
archive.hint: The workspace's messages in a format archiving systems take in, with their edits and deletions marked.
archive.dailyHint: After each day ends (UTC), its messages are written to the object store; download them here.
archive.noStorage: Daily exports need the object store, which this server does not have.
archive.failed: The archive could not be made. Try again.

mls.before: Sent before this device joined; bring your history here with your recovery key (Settings → Account).
mls.broken: This encrypted message cannot be opened on this device.
mls.fileFailed: The file could not be opened.
mls.enableHint: Only the devices of members can read new messages, not the server. Bots, search, link previews and scheduled messages stop working here.
mls.enableDescription: New messages and files can be read only on members' devices. Earlier messages stay as they are. Encryption cannot be turned off again.
mls.infoHint: Each member's devices hold their own keys (MLS). Compare a device's fingerprint with its owner to verify it.
mls.settingsHint: Your devices that can read encrypted channels. Remove one you no longer use: it leaves every encrypted channel.
mls.removeDeviceDescription: It can no longer read encrypted channels. Using it again makes it a new device.
mls.recoveryOn: Your history in encrypted channels is backed up with your recovery key.
mls.recoveryElsewhere: You have a recovery key. Enter it to bring your encrypted history to this device.
mls.recoveryOff: Make a recovery key to keep your encrypted history and read it on new devices.
mls.escrowNotice: Your organization keeps a copy of recovery keys and can open backed-up history.
mls.codeShown: Write this code down and keep it safe. It is shown only now.
mls.wrongCode: That is not your recovery key.
mls.newCodeDescription: Your current backups are deleted; devices back up again from now on with the new key.
